briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models in July 2026. Investment continues at record pace while safety concerns mount over agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with multi-agent orchestration capabilities. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus and DeepSeek launched R2, narrowing the gap with Western labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced a new 200k H100 cluster in Texas. xAI expanded Colossus to 500k GPUs while TSMC reported record AI chip demand.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks in the US and EU slow frontier model deployment enough to allow Chinese labs to close the capability gap by 2027?
